name: Natalie Stone
office: Associate Justice, Court of Appeal, Second District, Division Seven

items.text: Natalie Stone has been an Associate Justice of the California Court of Appeal, Second District, Division Seven, since 2024. She became a Los Angeles Superior Court judge in 2015, presiding over juvenile dependency cases. Earlier, she practiced civil litigation at Munger, Tolles & Olson and was an appellate court attorney. In 2025, she reversed a murder conviction over a judge's texts to prosecutors and upheld docked-vessel emissions rules.
